transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. Before we get started, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um… mostly I’ve been making these small mistakes that I really shouldn’t be making. Like on applications or research notes, I’ll miss a question or label something wrong, like an artwork date, even when I thought I checked it. It’s embarrassing, and it’s happened enough that I figured I should come in.
When you notice yourself making these mistakes, are you also feeling anxious or worried a lot of the time, or does it happen even when you're feeling calm and relaxed?

It’s not always when I’m anxious, no. A lot of the time I feel pretty calm, and I still end up turning in something with a small mistake—like a skipped question or a wrong artwork date—even though I thought I checked it. It’s kind of frustrating.
Have you noticed this kind of trouble with careless mistakes and attention going back to childhood or your school years, or is this something that's really only started recently?

Yeah… I think it goes back pretty far. In elementary school, teachers would say I had good ideas, but I’d forget to turn in worksheets or lose the instructions. I remember my parents having to check my backpack a lot, because otherwise I’d miss little details.
Right now, are these attention and carelessness issues causing real problems in more than one area of your life—like at work, at home, or in your relationships?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not like everything is falling apart, but it has caused problems. I’ve turned things in late, missed a couple application deadlines, and a mentor basically told me my follow-through is starting to hurt opportunities I should be ready for.
Aside from the attention issues, do you often feel restless, fidgety, or find yourself interrupting others or acting impulsively without thinking things through?

Not really the restless part so much. I guess I do sometimes talk too much when I get into an idea—like in seminars or gallery conversations. I’ll explain it for too long and then realize I didn’t really leave room for other people to say anything.
Do you often find it hard to stay focused during longer tasks, like reading a lengthy article or sitting through a lecture, even when you're interested in the topic?
I’m not totally sure. I mean, I can usually get through things if I have to, but longer readings or lectures can be… harder to stick with. It depends on the day, I guess.
Do you often lose or misplace things you need for tasks, like keys, paperwork, or your phone, or forget appointments and commitments in your daily life?

Yeah… more forgetting than losing things, I think. Like I’ll mean to return an email, pay a bill, pick up groceries—normal stuff—and then a few days later I realize I just never did it. It kind of just drops out of my mind.
